title: An ultra-high output self-managed power system based on a multilayer magnetic suspension hybrid nanogenerator for harvesting water wave energy
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1745-1755
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04205K, Paper
Ying Lou, Mengfan Li, Aifang Yu, Zhong Lin Wang, Junyi Zhai
The highly coupled energy self-management power system achieves a synergistic effect of 1 + 1 > 2 for a triboelectric–electromagnetic hybrid nanogenerator and efficiently enables water wave energy harvesting.
